metadata.title: विजय शाह इंटरव्यू | Who betrayed tribals in India | Latest Kunwar Vijay Shah interview
metadata.description:
In a compelling interview with Shyam Sunder, Editor of Main Bhi Bharat, Kunwar Vijay Shah, the Minister for Tribal Affairs in Madhya Pradesh, sheds light on the state's extensive efforts in uplifting its tribal communities. As the state with the largest tribal population in India, Madhya Pradesh has implemented a variety of policies aimed at fostering development in key areas such as education, health, and cultural preservation.

Minister Shah acknowledges significant challenges, including high school dropout rates and malnutrition in tribal areas. He highlights ongoing efforts to address these issues through improved educational opportunities and better healthcare services. Additionally, he mentions that the Central Tribal Minister has promised to tackle the language barriers in Eklavya Model Residential Schools (EMRS). The interview offers valuable insights into the Madhya Pradesh government's commitment to enhancing the lives of its tribal residents and ensuring sustainable and inclusive growth.
